source_pr_title: fix(drill): retry-safe drillUp — idempotent prevention creation
author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**WARNING:** Unvalidated `bd dep list` response — silent degradation resurrects the duplicate-on-retry bug

`bdJson<DrillRow[]>(...)` assumes this query returns hydrated issue rows (`id`, `title`, `status`, `labels`) and that `--direction=up` yields dependents of the frame. If bd's dep listing returns dependency-edge objects instead (the `{issue_id, depends_on_id, type}` shape the codebase itself models for `blocks` edges in molecule.ts), every row fails the `row.labels?.includes(PREVENTION_LABEL)` check, `reuse` stays empty, and `planPreventions` degrades to create-always — exactly the retry duplication this PR fixes — with no error surfaced. The same silent outcome occurs if a bd upgrade changes the direction semantics. Since this boundary is the retry-safety core, validate the row shape (or hydrate edge ids via `bd show`) so a wrong-shaped response fails loudly instead of masking as "no priors".

body:
**SUGGESTION:** Title dedupe is exact-match — whitespace variants still duplicate

`reuse.has(item)` and the Set both compare the raw string, so `--prevent "handle race"` and `--prevent "handle race "` (trailing space) produce two distinct beads. Trimming (and arguably case-folding) both the item key and `row.title` would close the remaining gap in the same-title dedupe contract.

A test with a stubbed `bd` whose `delete` fails would pin the "cleanup incomplete: prevention bead(s) left behind: …" contract this PR introduces.

**SUGGESTION:** Rewrapped error loses the original stack and cause

Even when there are no orphans, the original error is flattened to a message string in a fresh `Error` — stack trace and error type are gone. `claimFrame` (frames.ts:141) rethrows the original when cleanup succeeds; keeping that convention here, or attaching `{ cause: err }`, would keep the mid-flight failure debuggable.
